tasks.short: Arrange the music to the purpose.

steps.what: Show the source score already held for this arrangement.
Arrange and edit the music to fit the style and the purpose.
Reject a bar that no longer fits that purpose.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the source score if the company already holds it. The musician arranges and edits the music to the style and the purpose, and rejects a bar that no longer fits. The score is not arranged by the screen. A job with no source score leaves the screen blank, and the musician arranges from the part in hand.
tasks.previous_blocker: The source was one edition and the purpose was a mail, and they were not in the same place.
tasks.enabler_now: The source score can be shown. Arranging it to the purpose stays with the musician.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a bar fits the style is the musician's ear, not a field on the score.
tasks.human_edge: The musician arranges and rejects a bar. The source score is the material, not the arrangement.
tasks.altitude: The arrangement stays with the musician. The source score is visible, and no bar is written by the screen.

reach.task: Reshape material to a purpose and reject what no longer fits.
reach.learn: The source is not the new version.

evidence.claim: Showing a source score already held is a lookup. It does not arrange or edit the music.
Rejecting a bar is the musician's judgement of style and purpose. The score does not contain that judgement.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.

Fields: The score id only if the source is already held. The purpose is not a field the screen fills, and no arrangement is generated. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the score from the document store.
unknowns: Whether arrangements are owned by this musician or by an arranger on the same engagement.
research_questions: Who states the purpose before the musician arranges?

already_counted.description: Arranging and rejecting a bar stay with the musician.

incremental.description: File the source score against the arrangement once the job closes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still arranges and edits the music and still rejects a bar that misses the purpose. Only showing a source score already held is removed. No arrangement is generated, and a job with no score saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the tune already named on this performance's set list.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the tune name if it is already on the set list for the performance. The musician improvises during the performance. The name does not improvise, and no line is generated to play back. A performance with no set list leaves the screen blank, and the musician improvises on what the group is playing.
tasks.previous_blocker: The tune was called in the room, and there was no list to confirm the name.
tasks.enabler_now: A tune already on the set list can be shown. The improvisation stays with the musician in the performance.
tasks.still_hard: An improvised line is made in the moment, with the other players, and cannot be stored in advance.
tasks.human_edge: The musician improvises. A tune name is not the line.
tasks.altitude: Improvisation stays in the performance. No musical line is generated, and the set list only shows a name already written.

reach.learn: A scene heading is not the improvisation.

evidence.claim: A tune name already on a set list is a label. It does not improvise the music.
No line is generated for playback. The improvisation is the musician's, during the performance.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.
Fields: The performance id and the tune name only if the set list already has it. No notes are generated. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the set list from the document store.
unknowns: Whether the set list names tunes or only the set times.
research_questions: Who writes the set list before the performance?

already_counted.description: Improvising during the performance stays with the musician.

incremental.description: Drop set lists for performances that have closed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still improvises during the performance. Only showing a tune name already on the set list is removed. No line is generated, and a performance with no list saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the audition time and the required piece already stated.
Audition for orchestras, bands, or other musical groups.
Note the piece that was asked, and do not rank anyone.

tasks.design: The {CALENDAR} shows the audition time and the required piece if both are already stated. The musician auditions for the orchestra, the band, or the other group. The note records the piece that was asked. It does not rank the musician or anyone else. The call time does not audition. An audition with no stated piece leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The time and the piece were a mail, and the musician arrived prepared for a different excerpt.
tasks.enabler_now: A stated time and piece can be shown. The audition itself is the playing, in the room.
tasks.still_hard: How the excerpt is played for that group is the audition, and it cannot be scored in advance.
tasks.human_edge: The musician auditions. The note names the piece asked and ranks nobody.
tasks.altitude: The audition stays in the room with the musician. The note does not rank candidates, and the call time is only a time.

reach.task: Audition with the piece that was asked.
reach.learn: A call time is not a ranking.

evidence.claim: Showing an audition time and a required piece already stated is a lookup. It does not play the audition.

Filtering or evaluating candidates, including performers at an audition and including self-employment, is a high-risk use. This task does not rank the musician or other candidates. The note only names the piece that was asked.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.

Fields: The audition id, the time, and the required piece only if already stated. No score and no rank are produced. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the call from the calendar. Do not add a comparison of candidates.
The note names the piece. It is not an evaluation of the musician.
unknowns: Whether the panel wants a recorded audition or only a live one.
research_questions: Who states the required piece before the musician prepares?

already_counted.description: Auditioning and noting the piece asked stay with the musician.

incremental.description: Clear audition calls that have passed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still auditions for the group. Only showing a time and a piece already stated is removed. Nobody is ranked. An audition with no stated piece saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform for the screen or the microphone.

steps.what: Show the call time and the scene already on the production schedule.
Perform in television, radio, or movie productions.

tasks.design: The {CALENDAR} shows the call time and the scene if they are already on the production schedule. The musician performs for the television, radio, or movie production. The schedule does not perform the scene. A production with no call time leaves the screen blank. No performance is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: The call time was a mail the night before, and the scene number did not match the score in the bag.
tasks.enabler_now: A call time already on the schedule can be shown. The performance on the set or in the booth stays with the musician.
tasks.still_hard: Hitting the scene, with picture or with the booth clock, takes the musician there.
tasks.human_edge: The musician performs. The schedule only says when and which scene, if it already says so.
tasks.altitude: Screen and microphone work stays with the musician. The schedule shows a call time already written and does not perform the scene.

reach.task: Be on set for the scene the schedule names.
reach.learn: The schedule does not play the scene.

evidence.claim: A call time and a scene already on a schedule are a lookup. They do not perform the television, radio, or movie work.
No performance is generated. The musician plays or sings the scene.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.

Fields: The production id, the call time, and the scene only if already on the schedule. The scene is not invented. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the schedule from the calendar already used by the production.
unknowns: Whether the musician is on camera, in a booth, or in a pit for this production.
research_questions: Who publishes the call time the musician is expected to trust?

already_counted.description: Performing the scene stays with the musician.

incremental.description: Clear call times for scenes that were cut.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still performs for television, radio, or the movie. Only showing a call time and a scene already on the schedule is removed. No performance is generated, and a production with no call time saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The musician still arranges, still improvises, still auditions, and still performs on a set. Nobody is ranked for an audition. A source score can be opened, and it is not the arrangement.
reach: Art directors reshape existing material, and this job learns the source score is not the arrangement.
Actors audition in the room, and this job learns a call time is not a ranking.
skills_to_grow: Arrange from the source score, and reject a bar that misses the purpose.
Improvise in the performance. Do not play back a generated line.
Audition as the musician. Do not rank candidates.
role.ambitious_version: Arranging, improvising, auditioning, and screen work stay with the musician. An audition list is a call time, not a ranking of performers.
